name: Clipboard to Editor
description: Dumps whatever is on the clipboard into a fresh Notepad window and saves it. Useful for grabbing a snippet out of a browser without losing it.

actions.comment: Nothing to paste is a user error, not a failure worth a log entry.

then.reason: Nothing on the clipboard to capture.

actions.comment: The window can exist before it is ready to accept input.
Synthetic input is a last resort here — Notepad has no CLI for content. It will silently do nothing if Notepad somehow runs elevated.
Open the save dialog and leave it for the user to name the file.
